day_shape: IDF and Shin Bet claim killing of new Hamas military chief Mohammed Odeh in Gaza City strike; IDF pushes north of Lebanon Yellow Line with mass evacuation warnings; Rubio says Iran talks 'a few days' away; CENTCOM denies Hormuz escort resumption while citing 108 vessels redirected.

threads.label: Hamas military chief targeted in Gaza
threads.summary: The IDF and Shin Bet announced the killing of Mohammed Odeh, head of Hamas's military wing, in a strike on buildings in Gaza City, 11 days after the elimination of his predecessor Izz al-Din al-Haddad. Defense Minister Israel Katz and PM Netanyahu confirmed the operation in a joint statement.

threads.label: IDF pushes past Lebanon Yellow Line
threads.summary: The IDF moved north of its Lebanon security zone with Netanyahu saying Israel is seizing 'strategic positions' to deter Hezbollah drones, and the IDF Arabic spokesperson issued evacuation warnings for Tyre, Nabatieh, the Bekaa Valley and dozens of villages. Lebanon reported 31 killed Tuesday in Israeli strikes; Defa Press said Hezbollah claimed 32 operations in 24 hours.

threads.label: US-Iran negotiation track and Hormuz posture
threads.summary: Secretary of State Rubio said negotiations with Iran will take 'a few days,' with an Israeli official telling the Jerusalem Post 'Mojtaba is difficult to reach,' while CENTCOM denied media reports that Project Freedom escorts had resumed in the Strait of Hormuz and said 108 commercial vessels had been redirected under the US blockade. Khamenei adviser Velayati told IRIB that 'the tangible guarantee of agreement survival is the Strait of Hormuz,' and China urged parties to honour the ceasefire.

threads.label: Regime channels frame post-war narrative
threads.summary: IRIB and Defa Press posted items claiming a '40-day war' shattered US deterrence, alleging Pentagon casualty cover-ups via The Intercept, and accusing Starlink of guiding drones into Iran. The Ministry of Intelligence issued a statement framing recent events as part of a '47-year hybrid war' led by Zionism with British and European complicity.

threads.label: Iran internal: executions, sentencing, internet
threads.summary: Times of Israel reported Iran executed a man over alleged Mossad cooperation and that the judiciary suspended a presidential body after it ordered internet access restored, while the Jerusalem Post reported a two-year sentence for an Iranian accused of distributing candies after Khamenei's assassination. Defa Press said Tabriz International Airport, hit during the war, will reopen on 6 Khordad.

threads.label: Khamenei succession and Hajj messaging
threads.summary: Khamenei's office circulated a Hajj-pilgrimage message read at the Arafah disavowal ceremony and Eid al-Adha content, while IRIB carried a statement from envoy Vakilpour saying 'Imam Seyyed Mojtaba Khamenei is now standing with all his might... in charge of the overall management of the country and the war front.' An Israeli official told the Jerusalem Post that Iran negotiations are slow because 'Mojtaba is difficult to reach.'

threads.label: Iran-linked cyber activity
threads.summary: Israeli researchers attributed a Los Angeles transit system breach to Iranian hackers, and the Jerusalem Post reported the Iran-backed Handala group published a bounty list targeting Israelis and claimed to have intercepted the Gaza flotilla. Israel's state comptroller found the government was particularly vulnerable to cyberattacks during the war with Iran.
